About This Application

This is an interactive prototype designed to help middle school students learn algebra using multimodal AI.

The application uses Gemini Flash 2.0 to analyze student math work and identify common misconceptions in algebra learning.

Key Features:

  • Camera capture for math work analysis
  • Image upload capability
  • AI-powered misconception detection
  • Personalized feedback for students
  • History tracking of detected misconceptions
Technical Details: This application consists of:
  • A FastAPI backend with Gemini Flash 2.0 integration
  • API endpoints for misconception detection and image analysis
  • A frontend interface for capturing and uploading images

Backend API: https://math-misconception-api-ntuiyndx.fly.dev/

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/stefania11/math-misconceptions
